verdict.rationale: Community Phone has a management dashboard and app for lines, users and numbers, so bulk operations are a fair question for it. The evidence never documents acting on many items at once (bulk edits, batch imports or mass actions). 'Ring multiple numbers at once' is a call-routing feature, and 'manage every number' describes per-item administration, so neither is a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
